package.name: fast_xdebug
package.summary: Fast, Xdebug-API-compatible code coverage (line, branch, path) for PHP.
package.description: fast-xdebug is a PHP Zend extension that provides code coverage (line, branch and path) through the Xdebug coverage API, so PHPUnit / php-code-coverage / Cobertura tooling consume it unchanged. It analyses each op_array into basic blocks once and records one byte per executed block at runtime, reconstructing lines/branches/paths at collection time. Branch and path coverage therefore cost about the same at runtime as line coverage -- roughly an order of magnitude faster than Xdebug for path coverage. Coverage only (no debugger, profiler or tracer).
package.notes: 0.3.0: saturation fast-path -- once an op_array is fully covered, the per-opcode handler short-circuits it, making line coverage ~1.9x faster than 0.2.0 (below pcov on the benchmark). Adds opt-in --enable-fast-xdebug-native (-O3 -march=native; default build stays portable). Coverage + Cachegrind profiler; step debugging (DBGp) still specified-not-implemented. PHP 8.2-8.5.
